review.en: Brian Wilson made this record largely without the touring band, arranging for Los Angeles session players and writing most lyrics with Tony Asher. Bicycle bells, French horn, theremin-like tones and layered harmonies serve songs about doubt and growing up. Paul McCartney has named it a spur for Sgt. Pepper; studio pop after it aimed higher.
review.zh: 布莱恩·威尔逊在乐队巡演时，几乎独自完成了这张唱片：为洛杉矶的录音乐手写编曲，歌词多与托尼·阿舍合写。自行车铃、圆号和层层和声，托着关于迷惘与成长的歌。麦卡特尼说它推动了《佩珀军士》，此后的录音室流行乐都把目标定得更高。
